title: The Mech
description:
Name: [The Harbinger](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/harbinger.png:150:150)
Known Locations: Underground
Estimated Size: Large
Behavior: Once activated with a [Nether Star](image:minecraft:nether_star.png:50:50), it begins attacking all entities with its multiple heads and large weapon supply. The Harbinger routinely switches between Wither Missiles and lasers, announced with a mechanical hiss during each transition. It can also launch Wither Howitzers around itself to create large explosions, and charge up a powerful dash that destroys nearby blocks. Routinely charges a powerful laser beam to sweep the arena. At 50% health, it puts up a shield that deflects projectiles and becomes more aggresive. Within the arena are several EMPs that can stun The Harbinger if activated close by.
Danger Level: §8§lDeadly
